## About
Custom Concept Collision is a family-owned auto body shop in Oak Park, MI. Our shop is grounded in the belief that community comes first, and we treat our customers like family while getting them back on the road quickly and safely.
We're an independent shop that puts your needs first. We don't cut corners. We focus on doing what's right for you and your vehicle, with strong, reliable parts that are made to last.
We're rated 4.9 on Google from 158 reviews. Reviewers thank Carlos for rust work other shops wouldn't take on, and they mention Steve and the team by name.

## Services
- Collision Repair: From minor dents to significant structural damage, we restore your vehicle to its original condition.
- Auto Body Repair & Paint: Fender, dent, bumper, scratch and hail repair, headlight replacement and frame straightening, matched to exact factory color.
- Rust Repair: Advanced techniques and premium materials for long-lasting protection, backed by a lifetime guarantee.
- Frame Repair: Frame work done with care, including trucks other shops turned away.
- Tesla Collision Repair: Collision repair for Tesla vehicles.
- Classic Car Restorations: Whether it's a full restoration or a small fix, your vintage vehicle gets precision and care.
- Custom Paint & Graphics: Custom paint and refinishing, from full vehicles to intricate motorcycle details.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Contact us for a free, no-obligation estimate and we'll work with you on a repair plan that fits your needs, timeline, and budget.

Q: Do you work with my insurance?
A: We accept all car insurance, and we also take direct customer pay.

Q: Can you help with a rental car?
A: Yes, we offer supplemental car rental. One customer said we helped with rental car troubles along the way.

Q: Do you offer towing?
A: Yes, towing is one of the services we provide.

Q: Is detailing included?
A: Yes, professional detailing is included with your repair.
